reason: I'm not forwarding my clients' invoices and bank-transfer screenshots to a bot I've never heard of and linking it to my Google account. If a client asks where their data goes under UU PDP, I need an answer, and the offer doesn't give me one.
objection: It reads like one account, one sheet. I have 20 clients and each one has to stay in its own chat and its own sheet. With 20 clients I'd hit 500 documents a month quickly, and $79 is a big chunk of what I earn for a tool I can't vouch for.
would_change_my_mind: A clear statement of where documents are stored and who can see them, UU PDP compliant, plus a separate sheet per client chat under one account priced for a solo bookkeeper.
